scope: 1 newly recognized component, 1 fully supported card. Prior supported programs and metadata unchanged.
source: Rainier English card text included verbatim per component; conversion input matched by stable card ID.

ruleReferences.usedFor: Official Snorlax Good Sleep text: heal all HP only when this Pokemon did not recover from sleep during Checkup.
Checkup F: ordered indivisible status checks, other Checkup effects can occur before/after that block, and KOs are checked after all Checkup effects.

evidence.name: Good Sleep
evidence.textEn: If this Pokémon remains Asleep during Pokémon Checkup, heal all damage from this Pokémon.
evidence.textZh: 当这只宝可梦处于睡眠状态时，在宝可梦检查中，如果这只宝可梦没有从睡眠状态恢复的话，则回复这只宝可梦的全部HP。
